Robert Nesta Marley  (6 February 1945 – 11 May 1981) was a Jamaican reggae singer, songwriter, and guitarist.
Considered one of the pioneers of the genre, he was renowned for his distinctive vocal and songwriting style.
Marley increased the visibility of Jamaican music worldwide and became a global figure in popular culture.

The Wailers released 11 more studio albums, and after signing to Island Records, changed their name to Bob Marley and the Wailers.

This is the discography of French DJ and producer Bob Sinclar.

He has released seven studio albums.
